## Product
- **Name:** Twela / تويلا
- **Type:** personal finance tracker — expense ledger + debts + savings goals (inferred: `lib/models/` = transaction, debt, savings_goal, savings_entry, budget_settings, wallet_settings; `lib/providers/` = twela, debt, savings, routine, settings)
- **Platforms:** mobile (Android confirmed by `android/` + Gradle setup, iOS scaffold present but unconfigured)
- **Languages:** ar RTL primary (confirmed: `locale: Locale('ar','LY')` hardcoded in `lib/app.dart`); `en` scaffolded in `lib/l10n/app_en.arb` but **never used by screens** (confirmed: all UI copy is hardcoded Arabic strings)
- **Devices / constraints:** low-end Android (Nothing Phone named in `re_v1.md` P2), **offline-first** (all data local: `shared_preferences` + `flutter_secure_storage` + `encrypt`), money in LYD with 2 decimals, Arabic numerals are the *cause* of most reported "broken Arabic" bugs
- **Non-goals:** no server, no login, no multi-currency, no maps, no camera

## Identity
- **Base:** INB v2 (see skill `inb-design`). Brand mark: the INB/Twela wordmark on splash (onboarding) and footer only.
- **Source of truth for this file:** `re_v1.md` (the reconstruction plan) is the *functional* constraint; `inb-design` is the *visual* constraint. Where they collide, the resolution column of the matrix in `DESIGN-PLAN.md` decides.

## Profile for this product
- **Density:** `comfortable` on hero surfaces (home, savings detail, stats summary) and `compact` on data lists (history, debts, savings list, transaction log) — 44 px rows, list spacing 8/12/16 (inferred from `re_v1.md` ERP row rule + the domain table)
- **Hero element on the home screen:** the **total balance as one giant number** inside the dark island, with the mint glow behind it (confirmed requirement: "user should understand their financial state in under 2 seconds", `re_v1.md` P1)
- **Where the dark island is used:** **Home screen only** — 1 island max per mobile screen, per skill rule
- **Where the rose tile is used:** **Home screen only** — one rose Bento tile carrying the active savings goal (motivation + entry point). No other screen gets a rose tile.
- **Where cell frames are used:** Stats screen (KPI cells), Savings goal detail (target / elapsed / remaining cells), Debt detail (total / paid / remaining cells)
- **Motion level:** `normal` — one `Reveal` entrance per screen, `PressScale` on every tappable, `CountUp` on the balance only, no looping

## Elements map (fills the coverage matrix in DESIGN-PLAN.md)
- **Home headline (big):** Arabic 700 at 56–64 px, line-height 1, **no negative letter-spacing** (Arabic must not be tightened) — `أموالك` / `رصيدك اليوم` style greeting headline
- **Hero island content:** `الرصيد الإجمالي` micro-label → giant mono LYD amount → two mini cells (كاش / مصرف) → mint notch action = `+` (add movement) on the bottom-start corner
- **Rose frame:** **yes** — the home island sits inside `RoseFrame` with `notchColor: c.rose`
- **Photo card + progressive blur:** **N/A** — this is a numbers product, there is no photo to show; a fake photo would be decoration. The skill rule "progressive blur is required wherever text overlays an image" therefore has no surface here. *(Replaced by: the dark island + mint radial glow, which is the only permitted gradient in the app.)*
- **Soft 3D object:** **N/A** — no Rive/Spline/3D asset exists in the repo and a money app should not ship a decorative 3D blob; the island orb in the prototype is replaced by the **3D-soft coin stack** rendered with `CustomPainter` gradients (paper→mint radial) directly on the island, which is the *reference* implementation of "3D soft realism" without an external asset
- **Capsule / avatar tiles:** **yes** — a rotated-capsule tile in the home bento listing **categories** (the closest thing to "services" in a ledger app); the overlapping-avatar cluster is **N/A** (no people/teams in a single-user ledger; people appear one-by-one in the debts list instead)
- **Cell frames used on:** Stats, Savings goal detail, Debt detail, Home mini cells
- **Navigation:** **glass bottom bar** (`GlassBar`) with a sliding ink indicator, **4 items** — الرئيسية / السجل / الديون / الإحصائيات. Settings moves to a **top-start icon button** in the home header (and stays reachable from the `+` sheet) so the bar never exceeds 4 items.
- **Wordmark:** `Twela` in the home header (mono), INB-style pixel wordmark reserved for the onboarding splash and the settings footer

## Typography & Arabic rules (the "Arabic is broken" workstream)
These are **hard rules**, not preferences. They fix the reported bug directly.

1. **One Arabic family for all UI text:** IBM Plex Sans Arabic, weights 400 and 700 only (`GoogleFonts.ibmPlexSansArabicTextTheme`). The current app mixes the platform Naskh font with Latin `Space Mono` numbers → that mismatch is the main visual breakage.
2. **Every number is Latin and mono:** `Space Mono` via `monoStyle()`. Latin digits are the norm in Libyan banking apps; Arabic-Indic digits are **banned** in this app.
3. **Dates are Latin digits + Arabic month names:** `dd/MM/yyyy` and `د 14 نوفمبر 2026`. `intl`'s `DateFormat(..., 'ar')` is banned because it emits Arabic-Indic digits (`٢٠٢٦/١١/١٤`) that fight the mono numbers. A `latn()` helper converts any intl-produced string if needed.
4. **Money is one atomic unit:** a dedicated `Money` widget (number + `د.ل`) built as an explicit `Row` in RTL order — number first (rightmost), currency second. Never interpolate a formatted amount into an Arabic sentence string, because `"${a} / ${b}"` reorders unpredictably across bidi runs.
5. **No raw string concatenation of Arabic + numbers.** Every mixed line is a `Row`/`RichText` with explicit spans.
6. **All copy goes through `lib/l10n` (`AppLocalizations`).** Every screen today hardcodes Arabic; the `ar`/`en` arb files must grow to cover all screens so the language setting is real, not decorative.
7. **Directional everything:** `EdgeInsetsDirectional`, `AlignmentDirectional`, `PositionedDirectional`. `Icons.chevron_left` **auto-mirrors** in Flutter (`matchTextDirection: true`) so the current drill-in chevron points the wrong way in RTL — replace with `chevron_right` (mirrors to left = forward in RTL) or an explicit `Transform`.
8. **Font files are bundled, not fetched.** `google_fonts` downloads at runtime → the app breaks offline and on first launch without network. Four families are vendored into `assets/fonts/` and declared in `pubspec.yaml`.

## Semantic colour system (reconciliation of `re_v1.md` P0 + INB)
`re_v1.md` demands distinct semantic colours; INB demands a restrained ink/paper/mint/rose/indigo identity. Resolution: **INB governs the surface** (paper, ink, island, mint, rose, indigo, hairlines). **The four semantic hues govern money only**, desaturated to sit on cream, and never used as a background wash or a gradient.

| Meaning | Light | Dark | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| income / دخل | `#0E6B43` | `#4FD68B` | income amounts, `+` |
| expense / صرف | `#B33A2E` | `#FF8F7E` | expense amounts, `−` |
| debt (I lent) / دين | `#9A6A06` | `#E5B54A` | debt tile, "أنا أعطيت", warm warnings |
| savings / ادخار | `#0E7683` | `#55CEDA` | savings goal, savings tile |
| info / statistics | `#4747E0` | `#8B8BFF` | stats, badges, links, focus — **indigo, INB-native** |
| danger | `#A32E22` | `#FF8F7E` | destructive actions only |
| mint `#3DDC84` | — | — | **islands and live indicators only**, never money |
| rose `#E3BDB4` / `#3A2A27` | — | — | **one home tile only** |

- Two documented deviations from the INB base rules, both required by `re_v1.md`:
  - **warm ochre for debt/warning** (INB says "no orange") — a money app must distinguish debt from expense; it is the only warm hue allowed.
  - **red and teal for expense/savings** (INB base has neither) — required by `re_v1.md` P0 "the color system must distinguish income/expense/debt/savings".
- INB wins on everything else: **no decorative gradients** (the app's current blue-purple screen gradient is deleted; the island glow is the only gradient), **borders over shadows** (the current `DaftarCard` drop shadows are removed), **no emoji as icons**.

## Savings domain rules (the product fix, not just a skin)
The current savings feature has a **model gap**, not just a UI gap: `SavingsProvider` exposes `pauseGoal`, `resumeGoal`, `updateGoal`, `deleteGoal` but **no screen ever calls them**, and there is no concept of money *leaving* a goal. A saved amount is therefore a one-way trap.

### Model changes
- `SavingsEntry` gains `type: SavingsEntryType { deposit, withdrawal }`, `linkedDebtId`, `linkedDebtName`.
- `TransactionType` gains `savingsWithdrawal` (money returning to a wallet) and the ledger treats it as a **credit**:
  `balance = initial + income + savingsWithdrawal − expense − debtGiven + debtReceived − debtPayment − savings`
- `SavingsGoal.copyWith` gains `startDate` and `notes` so a goal's term can be re-based.
- `SavingsGoal.status` keeps `active | paused | completed | deleted`; **`deleted` becomes a real soft state** so deletion is undoable.

### Goal lifecycle (all six actions the user asked for must be reachable in ≤ 2 taps)
| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| ادخار (deposit) | adds an entry + a `savings` ledger transaction |
| سحب نقدي (withdraw to wallet) | adds a **withdrawal** entry + a `savingsWithdrawal` ledger transaction → money returns to كاش/مصرف |
| تحويل إلى دين (transfer to a debt) | adds a **withdrawal** entry + a `debtPayment` ledger transaction on the chosen debt → the debt's remaining drops, the goal's saved drops, the wallet total is unchanged (money only moved between pots) |
| تعديل (edit) | name, daily target, duration, start date — target recalculates, progress recomputes |
| إيقاف مؤقت / استئناف (pause / resume) | `paused` blocks new deposits only; withdrawals stay allowed (money must always be recoverable) |
| حذف (delete) | soft delete + ledger reversal + **snackbar undo**; undo restores the goal, its entries and its ledger transactions |

### Rules
- A goal's saved amount is **always derived** from its entries (`deposits − withdrawals`), never stored independently, so it can never drift.
- `completed` is derived from `saved ≥ target`; a withdrawal that drops below the target returns the goal to `active` (except when paused).
- Withdrawing more than the goal holds is impossible; the amount field is capped and the button disables with a written reason.
- Only debts where **the user is the lender** (`isGiven == true`, `remaining > 0`) are offered as transfer targets, and the amount is capped by `min(goalSaved, debtRemaining)`.
- Transferring to a debt is confirmed with a plain summary line: "سيخرج 150.00 د.ل من الحصالة ويدخل سداد دين أحمد" — no surprise, one tap to confirm.

## Navigation architecture
- `MainScreen` keeps a single `Scaffold` with `extendBody: true`, a `GlassBar` bottom navigation (4 destinations + a centre `+` slot with a sliding ink indicator) and **no floating action button** — the `+` lives in the home island's notch and in the nav's centre slot, so it can never cover a nav item (`re_v1.md` P1 v9 bug).
- Screens are pushed as routes on the root navigator; the bottom bar is hidden on pushed routes.
- Every pushed route uses `InbPageTransition`.
- `SafeArea` + `MediaQuery.padding.top` are handled once, in a shared `InbScreen` scaffold wrapper — no per-screen hardcoded top padding (`re_v1.md` P0).

## Decisions log
<!-- One line per decision: date, what, why. -->
- 2026-11-14 — **Adopt INB v2 as the visual system** (paper/ink, island, mint, rose, indigo) and keep `re_v1.md` as the functional contract; the two plans are merged instead of run in sequence. *Why: the user asked for both at once.*
- 2026-11-14 — **Bottom bar = 4 items, settings moves to the home header.** *Why: INB caps mobile bottom bars at 4; no functionality is lost because settings stays one tap away and remains in the `+` sheet.*
- 2026-11-14 — **Warm ochre + red + teal admitted as money-only semantic hues.** *Why: `re_v1.md` P0 requires income/expense/debt/savings to be distinguishable; they are never used as surface washes, gradients or decorations.*
- 2026-11-14 — **Fonts are vendored into `assets/fonts/`, not fetched at runtime.** *Why: an offline-first money app must not depend on `fonts.gstatic.com` at launch.*
- 2026-11-14 — **Latin digits everywhere; `intl` Arabic date formatting is banned.** *Why: Arabic-Indic digits next to Space Mono numbers is the visible cause of the "Arabic is broken" complaint.*
- 2026-11-14 — **Savings withdrawal + transfer-to-debt added to the data model, not just the UI.** *Why: money must be able to leave a goal; the existing one-way `savings` transaction type cannot express it.*
- 2026-11-14 — **Savings deletion is soft + undoable.** *Why: skill UX rule — destructive actions are undoable before confirm dialogs are used.*
- 2026-11-14 — **Photo card and progressive blur marked N/A for this product.** *Why: a ledger has no imagery; a decorative photo would violate the anti-slop rules.*
- 2026-11-15 — **No `Color(0xFF…)` outside `lib/design/tokens.dart`, except two documented data palettes.** `lib/models/category.dart` (10 category swatches) and `lib/models/app_settings.dart` (4 user-selectable accent colors) are *data the user picks from*, not surfaces; every surface, text and icon color in `lib/screens/` comes from `context.inb` / `context.sem`. *Why: the audit rule must be checkable — this is the only carve-out.*
- 2026-11-15 — **Decorative gradients, box shadows and `Colors.white/black` removed from all screens.** Replaced with `c.paper` / `c.surface` / `c.line` and `c.onIsland` for icon/text on filled ink. *Why: INB base is warm paper + ink; the island glow is the only gradient allowed.*
- 2026-11-15 — **`InbSkeleton` added to `lib/design/` as the single loading state**, static when `MediaQuery.disableAnimations` is on. *Why: plan box 96 and the four-states rule need one shared skeleton.*
- 2026-11-16 — **Bottom nav becomes 5 slots: 4 destinations + a centre `+` slot.** The nav's `onAction` existed but was never rendered, which killed the movement sheet and the whole savings feature; the centre slot guarantees the action can never cover a destination (indicator math `slotOf(i) = i < 2 ? i : i + 1`). *Why: "no floating action button" is honoured, but an unrendered callback is worse than a FAB — the action must exist and be visible.*
- 2026-11-16 — **"Island" is a max-1 rule, not min-1.** Only the home balance is an island; every other screen is flat paper. *Why: correction of the earlier checklist wording — the hero must be singular, one island per app.*
- 2026-11-16 — **History edit reuses `AddTransactionScreen` with `existingTransaction:`** — the same screen creates and edits, preserving id/date/related-ids so ledger links survive. *Why: one screen, one filled button, no duplicate editor; editing must not break savings-transfer links.*
- 2026-11-16 — **The window draws edge to edge into the display cutout.** Android `values/styles.xml` + `values-night/styles.xml` set `windowLayoutInDisplayCutoutMode=shortEdges`, transparent system bars, contrast enforcement off, and the INB paper colour as `windowBackground`. *Why: without the cutout opt-in the system paints the notch strip black, which no Dart-side `SystemChrome` call can fix — the window has to allow it.*
- 2026-11-16 — **App-bar actions use `InbAppBarAction` only** (44 px paper pill, line border, `R.inner`, 48 px target). Hand-rolled tinted `Container` + `IconButton` boxes are retired. *Why: the savings `+` read as a 64 px block and every screen had a different action shape; one component keeps the top bar consistent.*
- 2026-11-16 — **Pie labels are fitted, not thresholded.** `InbPie` (`lib/design/pie.dart`) measures each label with the real font against the chord of its own wedge and degrades name+% → % → nothing; label ink flips by slice luminance. *Why: percentage thresholds cannot know how wide a given Arabic name is — that is exactly why the v2.0.4 labels still overlapped. Supersedes `fl_chart`, which is no longer a dependency.*
- 2026-11-16 — **The hero's one 3D object is `CoinStack` on the Home island**, beside the balance (not only on onboarding), and the balance is wrapped in `FittedBox(scaleDown)`. *Why: the matrix promised a 3D object on the hero; the claim must be true on the screen that carries it.*
- 2026-11-20 — **Charts get 3D Soft Realism as depth, not as tilt.** `InbPie` extrudes its ring downward with a wall one tone darker than the slice (`InbColors.dark.paper` mixed in), a light hairline bevel for thickness, and a flat top face. A tilted / rotated pie is rejected. *Why: the user asked why the pie was not 3D — the answer is that INB's 3D source means "soft object with real thickness", not "perspective". A tilted pie makes the back slices measure smaller than their value, so the depth would come at the cost of the number being true; and a glossy gradient extrusion would break "no decorative gradients".*
- 2026-11-20 — **Owner override for the final INB repair (A–G).** Supersedes, where they conflict: (1) **no English tech text anywhere** — `November 2026`, `INB / HOME`, `TOP /`, `ACTIVE / 1`, `0 ITEMS` and every Silkscreen pixel label are banned; dates are `16 نوفمبر 2026` from the Arabic table in `lib/design/format.dart`, and `InbFonts.pixel` survives only where the owner already signed it off (none on the four main screens). (2) **The `Twela` wordmark font is frozen** — Unbounded `displayStyle`, weight 700, letter-spacing ≈ −0.05em, line-height 1.0, name only. (3) **Navigation is `GlassBar` alone** — 4 tabs (icon + name, sliding indicator) with **one separate circular mint add button beside the bar, never inside it**, over `ProgressiveBlur` + a paper gradient ramp, and lists pad by the bar's height. This reverses the 2026-11-16 "5 slots / centre `+`" decision. (4) **No top navigation bar and no state switcher** — titles live in the scroll content.
- 2026-11-20 — **Money semantic palette, final:** income = mint-green (dark green on paper, mint in dark), expense = **ink** with an explicit `−`, savings = island green, debt = indigo, and faint red **only** for delete / late / error (budget warning uses the same faint red). Gold, ochre and orange are banned; red never marks an ordinary expense or savings. `InbSemantics` in `lib/design/tokens.dart` is the single source. *Why: this reverses the 2026-11-14 "ochre + red + teal" decision, which the owner has now withdrawn.*
- 2026-11-20 — **Every island carries three text tones only:** `onIsland`, `onIslandMuted` (`#A9C7B8`) and `mint`. Dark red / dark green on the island is banned (both were below 4.5:1 against `#0E2A21` / `#17382B`).
- 2026-11-20 — **Stats donut = option A, `ClayDonutPainter`** (a single `CustomPainter`, tilted `0.56`, extruded toward `#04100A`, drag-to-rotate, tap-to-lift with the centre text swapping). It replaces the flat `InbPie` **on the stats screen only**; `InbPie` stays for every other chart. The earlier "no tilt, data honesty" decision is superseded for stats by an explicit owner choice, and the honesty requirement is kept by ordering slices, capping the gap deduction and testing that segment sums equal the displayed total. Option B (a real 3-D scene) is offered later by the owner, not built now.
- 2026-11-20 — **Stats palette order is fixed:** `#3DDC84`, `#8B8BFF`, `#E3BDB4`, `#6E9C89`, `#E9DFC8`; the four largest categories keep a major hue and everything beyond them merges into «فئات صغيرة» (the earlier "under 5%" wording was an inference, not the owner's rule); colour follows the **category**, never the position, so a category never changes hue between months.
- 2026-11-22 — **Stats reads one filtered set, and its headline is the sum of its own segments.** `buildStatsSegments` (pure, `lib/screens/stats/stats_screen.dart`) merges the month's expenses after the same wallet filter as Home (الكل / كاش / مصرف) and the same month navigator; the island's total, the legend percentages and the «أكبر الفئات» rows all come from that list. `test/design/donut_geometry_test.dart` pins `total == sum(segments)`, which makes the old «المصروفات 0.00» against 1,096.50 impossible to repeat. *Why: the bug was two different data paths on one screen, not a formatting problem.*
- 2026-11-22 — **Palette collisions are resolved, not duplicated.** Ten categories share four major hues (`index % 4`), so clothing (7) and groceries (3) both want sage. Hues are handed out in stable catalogue order and a collision takes the next free slot, so the ring always shows four distinct major tones; the fifth tone stays reserved for «فئات صغيرة». *Why: the first build drew two sage slices and no indigo — the legend could not identify its own ring.*
- 2026-11-22 — **`ClayDonut` measures its own box and accumulates its drag.** The widget height is `width × 0.56 + depth` (a square box left two dead bands and made the donut look small); the painter derives `depth` from the box width so the geometry test and the drawn ring agree. Drag updates accumulate in the widget state, because several move events can arrive against the same `widget.rotation` between frames — without accumulation only the last delta survived (~8° instead of a full turn). *Why: measured on the emulator, not guessed.*
- 2026-11-22 — **`SoftOrb` is the Debts island's 3D object.** A 64 px radial clay sphere (mint-tinted body, one mint specular, 1 px rim) in `lib/design/widgets.dart`; it sits beside the remaining total rather than floating in the percentage row, so the island has one clear object and one clear money block. *Why: the 3D language must reach the secondary island too, and an invisible orb on the island colour was not an object.*
- 2026-11-22 — **Snackbars on the tab shell lift above the navigation ramp.** `showInbToast` checks for the shell's `bottomNavigationBar` and adds an 88 px bottom inset only there; pushed screens keep the normal margin. *Why: the nav's progressive blur sits over the toast and washed out the left half — including the «تراجع» action, which must stay legible for the undo window.*
- 2026-11-22 — **History delete stays instant + undoable, with a ⋮ menu instead of a confirm dialog**, and the ledger uses day headers (`الأحد · 15 نوفمبر 2026`) inside one labelled `CellFrame`. *Why: the owner retired confirm dialogs; grouping by day is what makes a month-long ledger scannable without an app bar.*
